chile.title: Flag of Chile

colors.note: Represents the sky and the Pacific Ocean

desc: - A blue square canton with a white star, above a white stripe and below a red stripe occupying the lower half
- Known as 'La Estrella Solitaria' (The Lone Star)
trivia:
- The blue canton represents the sky; white represents the Andes snow; red represents blood of independence
- The star represents progress guiding the nation
- Chile's flag has been in use since 1812, one of the longest continuously used flag designs in the Americas
